pre_stated_hypothesis.name: OBV-Price Slope Divergence Continuation (Accumulation/Distribution Proxy on Real Quote Volume)
pre_stated_hypothesis.description: Build causal OBV proxy OBV=cumsum(sign(ret1)*quote_volume_usdt) (integrated signed volume). Compute z-scored slopes over 24h (z lookback 168h) for OBV and price. When slopes diverge with magnitude (|obv_z|,|px_z|>=1.25, opposite signs): OBV up + price down -> LONG (accumulation continuation); OBV down + price up -> SHORT. Exit on realignment, weak OBV slope, max hold 12h, or flip. Execution t->t+1. WF 720/168/168, cost grid 0-40bps, B&H benchmark on same OOS windows.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c23: C23 uses high vol_z LEVEL for momentum continuation; C46 uses integrated signed volume (OBV) slope divergence.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c40: C40 fades HIGH volume climax (vol_z level); C46 uses OBV (sign(ret)*volume cumulative) slope vs price slope divergence — different construction.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c41: C41 continues on LOW vol_z dry-up breakout; C46 trades OBV-price slope divergences (accumulation/distribution), no dry-up/breakout condition.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c42: C42 confirms breakouts on volume expansion (rising vol_z); C46 uses signed integrated volume OBV slope, not expansion confirmation.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c43: C43 fades volume-price DIVERGENCE using vol_z (unsloped volume level z at price extremes) as a reversion fade; C46 uses OBV slope (integrated signed flow) vs price slope divergence as a CONTINUATION of hidden accumulation/distribution with different signal math (slope z-scores, opposite trade intent framing).
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c44: C44 trend-follows on vol_z ROC acceleration; C46 uses OBV cumulative signed-volume slope divergence, not volume acceleration.
pre_stated_hypothesis.differs_from_c45: C45 mean-reverts on illiquidity SHOCKS (|ret|/volume Amihud ratio z-score); C46 uses signed volume integration OBV vs price slopes — different transform and mechanic.

summary.edge_rule: exposure>0 AND all cost-grid slices OOS net>0 AND OOS net>B&H on same OOS windows (pre-stated, fail-closed)
